summary: Nebius Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, announcing its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results and a letter to shareholders. The filing includes consolidated financial highlights (revenues of $399M, adjusted EBITDA of $129.5M) and discloses a 1.2 GW power/land deal for an AI factory in Pennsylvania. No special situation event is present; this is a routine earnings release and operational update. No deal terms, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, or other special situation indicators are mentioned. The filing is a standard report of financial results with no extraordinary corporate action.
